services.title: Comprehensive Automotive Services
services.subtitle: Professional vehicle inspection, title deed verification, escrow payments, and brokerage support in Addis Ababa.

inspection.title: 50-Point Mechanic Diagnostic
inspection.desc: Complete mechanical, computer OBD-II, and chassis inspection performed by licensed technicians before any payment is made.

escrow.title: Bank-Secured Escrow Settlement
escrow.desc: Eliminate roadside cash risks. Funds are held in a secure commercial bank escrow account until the vehicle Libre is legally transferred.

libre.title: Title Deed (Libre) Verification
libre.desc: Instant verification with Ethiopian Transport and Police databases to confirm clear title and zero outstanding legal disputes.

brokerage.title: Transparent 1.5% Brokerage
brokerage.desc: Honest representation with fixed 1.5% fee. We never apply roadside hidden markups or arbitrary commissions.
